description: Karnataka deputy CM and Bengaluru development minister DK Shivakumar was speaking at Network18 Future of Work Summit
body_lead: India's tech capital's second airport will come up in south Bengaluru, Karnataka deputy CM and Bengaluru Development Minister DK Shivakumar confirmed at Network18 Future of Work Summit. Moneycontrol reported on March 19 that Chudahalli and Somanahalli on Kanakapura Road, along with a site on Nelamangala-Kunigal Road, have been shortlisted for the city’s second airport. Shivakumar’s statement indicates that the two locations on Kanakapura Road in south Bengaluru are frontrunners, even as the state government maintains that a final decision has not yet been taken.
